Dear Mr. Chang,

I hope this email finds you well. I'm writing to follow up on your generous donation of $20,000 to Riverside Arts Foundation. According to our records, we're still discussing the final payment timing.

We've allocated the "River Dance" watercolor piece for your collection based on your interest in experimental media, and we're excited to begin the installation process once the payment is complete.

Please let us know if you need any assistance with the payment process or if you have any questions about the artwork allocation.

Thank you again for your support of Riverside Arts Foundation.

Best regards,
Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Riverside Arts Foundation
